macros.name: banglaallcounters
macros.doc: banglaallcounters produces bangla numbering for everything in the whole article. banglaallcounters does not need any parameters.

macros.name: banglabold
macros.doc: banglabold bolds the Bangla texts provided inside the parameter.

macros.name: banglaenumerate
macros.doc: banglaenumerate produces level-2 bangla numbering for enumerate or the list in latex for the whole article. banglaenumerate does not need any parameters.

macros.name: banglaequation
macros.doc: banglaequation produces bangla numbering for all equations in the whole article. banglaequation does not need any parameters.

macros.name: banglafigure
macros.doc: banglafigure produces bangla numbering for all figures/images in the whole article. banglafigure does not need any parameters.

macros.name: banglaipa
macros.doc: banglaipa generates equivalent International Phonetic Alphabets(IPA) symbols for Bangla alphabets. banglaipa works on character, word, and sentences as well.

macros.name: banglaitalic
macros.doc: banglaitalic makes the Bangla texts italic provided inside the parameter.

macros.name: banglapage
macros.doc: banglapage produces bangla page numbering. banglapage does not need any parameters.

macros.name: banglasection
macros.doc: banglasection produces bangla numbering for all sections in the article including all subsections and subsubsections. banglasection does not need any parameters.

macros.name: banglatable
macros.doc: banglatable produces bangla numbering for all tables in the whole article. banglatable does not need any parameters.

macros.name: banglatext
macros.doc: banglatext displays any Bangla texts provided inside the parameter.

macros.name: banglatranslit
macros.doc: banglatranslit generates a comprehensive and sophisticated transliteration of Bangla into Latin based on ISO 15919. banglatranslit works on character, word, and sentences as well.
